name: Remote network intrusion
notes: Classic foothold, escalate, exfiltrate. With NET-01 deployed, the code and credential vectors are countered but V-NET-1 (residual) joins entry and exfil, so the stage never falls below V-NET-1: the reviewer's floor falls out of the structure. Planted USB (V-PHYS-2) and off-site laptops (V-PHYS-3) are entry here because the operator then works remotely.

name: Human insider
notes: Entry is getting a cooperating person (recruited, coerced, placed, or a vendor's staff). At an SL1 victim the insider's standing access (V-X-1) and carry-out (V-X-3/V-X-4) are certain, so insider carry-out is complete on its own until PER-06, KEY-01 or egress controls exist. Leadership-approved access (V-HUM-5) is an entry like any other: split custody and dual authorisation still apply.

name: Physical intrusion and seizure
notes: Someone gets to the hardware, reads or taps the weights, and carries them out. Armed break-in and military takeover (V-PHYS-6/7) skip exfil because they take the hardware, but still need a reach step to read it (KEY-01 strong). Wiretaps (V-NET-3) skip exfil.

name: Supply chain
notes: A compromised product, package or component gives a foothold inside the trusted boundary, including behind an air gap. Kept staged: an implant still has to reach the weights and get them out (covert channels are V-NET-1).

name: Served model
notes: Exists only if the model is served externally (world-state toggle). Prompt-triggered code execution or serving-stack bugs give a foothold on infrastructure that holds weights; model extraction (V-ML-4) needs nothing but the API, but a weight-scale volume of responses still has to leave through it (V-X-5, metered by AI-07). NET-01 does not apply: RAND exempts production serving.

name: The lab's own model as insider
notes: No entry stage: the model is already inside. Scored on AC bands, not OC tiers; SL5 must hold it separately (user decision). Unsanctioned internal workloads (V-SELF-6) skip exfil. V-SELF-4 is residual: a candidate only once overt egress is capped or inspected (NET-04 / AI-07). Sabotage of oversight (V-SELF-5) is not here: it is an integrity harm, scored on its own meter outside SL.

name: API distillation (capability copy)
notes: Its own meter, outside the headline: distillation copies capability, not weights.

name: Sabotage by the lab's own model
notes: Its own meter, outside SL and breach: subverting oversight, sandbagging and tampering with results damage integrity rather than move weights.
